result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, **Linear is the best overall project management tool** if you're building a tech or SaaS company.

However, the best choice depends on your startup's stage, team size, and how you work. A five-person startup needs something different from a 30-person company scaling its operations.

Here are the tools I'd shortlist.

## Top 5 project management tools for startups

![Fast growing startups are built on Linear](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/piHpddRS6n9dTggcCRU3QzspXui7xfTg4qksC0xamyVTz0l5rmZLEYCGsVB7KKUouzfiOTbe-9ydzUq7UB2MFrNbZIGlaUSNjP0C8Bhd2CXnbxL2xZ05zw3USDTcATN8Ed4Fr3ygsGaA-sAB5VFRUeF1jd3BNolTylsoZGFQvpYkliFtHTL_AgaQh3gID9Z3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent product roadmaps and sprint planning.
- Fast, clean interface.
- Great developer and GitHub integrations.
- Less suited to managing every business function.

[Visit Linear](https://linear.app/)

---

![Finastra Customer Story | ClickUp™](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/OXxUksa73j7hoTxbYQ6zo3pspX36GflPBLMsRWXjhfWZTJdFq6md_tXaxCCc_3Kjh0xQSrUSgXoCYi3d5TOe48r-mvzFwLplQbgf4lhsH3q_bsATt_hAcyva5qI1DtZG8OasgRxxldReZAIfURcJdNdt2Br8nPVvqn-lCO5aR2MxpFl9QAiCxibf4gzehOOb?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. ClickUp**

(Best all-in-one solution)

- Projects, tasks, documents and goals.
- Multiple views and dashboards.
- Automations and reporting.
- Can become complicated if over-customised.

[Visit ClickUp](https://clickup.com/)

---

![Project Management Hub Template by Gridvio | Notion Marketplace](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6e1oG6Y_aW5V5yDl222hE8Y8t-T__05L0OPLqrtY2b6KrmvS_M-QH4eaVLv4afPJUAGCFGr_eoifL-Irt3_HiUqUmKW08dRjhIxW2MfVWL_nPAWNaujkMp5zdq2VbJkW7b3h6jvrTVNAFmmVU9MPLCBztqWrhslDc_LeRhpbcV451et11onvlpgBLkBnIYcR?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion**

- Excellent for early-stage startups.
- Combines company wiki, documentation and tasks.
- Great for business plans, SOPs and meeting notes.
- Less powerful for complex project tracking.

[Visit Notion](https://www.notion.com/)

---

![New: Asana’s Milestones help you visualize project progress • Asana](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/045PY8MNTZCNbuEY_9zoc2ZmyVm82bEUQrACKq4DMJ2rZRzBOKtwnHDDeSB865DF__R-b4CGI6GEhHdu4YJMzkB1qcjJuCRLXmMhkxG9zfIfGx-0L1EgDFt_aMUwOdh5HR45ijTcFpeq8HRM8juB5v_Vffpp7OzTfiaEKInBCXkUCm5590f5v87DKC8sKsga?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana**

- Great for cross-functional teams.
- Clear task ownership and deadlines.
- Excellent project visibility.
- Particularly useful as teams grow.

[Visit Asana](https://asana.com/)

---

![Portfolio management - All Projects Dashboard – Support](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/-5NH-hROEcQXpSQPmMUJv0x7GODAoqXeNRlBaAmeb5yjL6ws1fsUSsHXZKs7cGHwGwKjC6qsKZvaA0-fO7oD8-9_bc-PbX0_EJ1QpOPifoMbrdCVNNuollQzaJIhYGySdgXpxRYlPlDaiOA8sl0RXCUZIj48mjl4S_hb7oB4Rygmeul72nI4kZxZvS769XKO?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Monday.com**

- Excellent visual dashboards.
- Good for sales, marketing, operations and delivery.
- Strong workflow automation.
- More structure than a tiny startup may need.

[Visit Monday.com](https://monday.com/)

## My recommendation by startup stage

| Startup situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| 1–3 founders, pre-launch | Notion |
| 3–10 people, tech startup | Linear + Notion |
| 5–20 people, mixed team | ClickUp |
| 10–30 people, scaling | Asana |
| Operations-heavy business | Monday.com |


These are practical starting points rather than strict size limits. The 2026 comparisons also highlight the importance of avoiding unnecessary complexity and software costs.
